scope: Cross-check of two independent computational placements on the same unannotated assembly: claude-evo's CDS-only GeneWise ortholog windows and this project's miniprot protein-to-genome best hits. Neither is an annotation or an orthology proof, so an agreement means two methods agree, not that a locus is correct.

dropped_hoxd13a.their_stated_drop_reason: no ortholog hit with a clean 2 kb ACGT-only window
dropped_hoxd13a.finding: A clean 2 kb ACGT-only window DOES exist immediately upstream of my hoxd13a hit on this strand. Their drop reason was 'no ortholog hit with a clean 2 kb ACGT-only window'; the two halves of that reason are separable, and this result is consistent with the ORTHOLOG-HIT half failing in their GeneWise model rather than the window being unclean. It does not show their model was wrong: my hit is a protein alignment, not an ortholog call, and my hoxd13a hit is the weakest in my table (coverage 0.824, identity 0.447).
